textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Verbs and tenses (additional, not in the textbook) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The present tense tells what happens now: She plays. The past tense tells what happened before: She played. The future tense tells what will happen: She will play.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The present tense tells what happens now: She plays. The past tense tells what happened before: She played. The future tense tells what will happen: She will play.
beats.speakEn: The present tense tells what happens now: She plays. The past tense tells what happened before: She played. The future tense tells what will happen: She will play.

beats.en: Most verbs add ed in the past: walk becomes walked. Some change fully: go becomes went, eat becomes ate and run becomes ran.
beats.speakEn: Most verbs add ed in the past: walk becomes walked. Some change fully: go becomes went, eat becomes ate and run becomes ran.
